actor:live.label: in the system
actor:live.note: membership: read from the dated system membership inside the panel window; past it the universe stands as it is

actor:polyarchy.label: Electoral democracy index
actor:polyarchy.note: the engine moves it by ±0.1 on a regime step; between steps it is held

actor:intrastate.label: Internal armed conflict
actor:intrastate.note: the engine writes level 1 and never 2 (intrastate_onset has no intensity): level 2 forward is a carried as-of spell, not a forecast

actor:occupied.label: Occupied
actor:occupied.note: occupation is data, not a hazard: carried from as-of

actor:great_power.label: Major power (CoW)
actor:great_power.note: fitted entry/exit transitions on the moved capability share (src/engine/greatpower.js, C2)

actor:nuclear.label: Nuclear weapons
actor:nuclear.note: world.nukes at as-of, then the fitted acquisition hazard (src/engine/nuclear.js, C4); disarmament is not modelled

actor:cinc.label: Capability (CINC)
actor:cinc.note: moved by each actor's simulated total output growth and renormalised (C1, src/engine/core.js:stepCinc) — an assumption: CINC tracks output only loosely

actor:wave.label: Regional wave (opening odds x)
actor:wave.note: exp(sigma u - sigma^2/2) for the opening template, u the region-year shock (AR(1), seeded from the wave visible at as-of); 1 = a quiet year

actor:union.label: Union
actor:union.note: open vocabulary: the union id (eu) or none

dyad:at_war.label: Pair at war
dyad:at_war.note: truth: the merged dyadic war spells src/engine/termination.js:warSpells builds from data/events.json

dyad:allied.label: Defence pact
dyad:allied.note: the dated pact graph (scripts/lib/hist.mjs:loadPacts) at as-of, moved by fitted formation / dissolution hazards (src/engine/alliances.js, C3)

dyad:presence.label: Military presence
dyad:presence.note: a great-power station of either side on the other (data/presence.yaml at as-of, then fitted open / close hazards: src/engine/stations.js, C6); the key is the sorted pair, the patron is the great power

dyad:trade.label: Trade dependence
dyad:trade.note: min(s_ij, s_ji), s = the pair's trade over each side's total recorded trade; the series ends 2006-2009 and carries; a forecast holds the as-of value

dyad:holds.label: Holds territory
dyad:holds.note: CShapes 2.0 holders (data/holders.json); with C5 breakup a territory can leave its holder in a run

dyad:colony.label: Holds a dependency
dyad:colony.note: colony, protectorate, mandate or occupation (CShapes 2.0 status)

record:status.label: Status
record:status.note: open vocabulary: the status words of data/corridors.yaml and data/territories.yaml; control transfer is not simulated

sources.cinc: CoW NMC 7.0 (1816–2022; peacesciencer distribution, scripts/fetch-nmc.mjs); occupied years carry the last pre-occupation observation forward rather than CoW's rump-regime figure (data/history/events.yaml kind: occupation, `occupied` = 1); 2023-2024 is the modern capability composite (milex<-milex irst<-gdp_ppp energy_nmc<-energy tpop<-tpop upop<-upop; milper not represented) spliced onto CINC over the 10 overlap years to 2022, scripts/lib/capability.mjs; 2025-2025 has no source and is left null — the engine carries the last value forward and records the staleness
sources.gdp_pc: Maddison Project 2023 via OWID (2011 intl $); entity-wide series (OWID_USS/OWID_YGS/OWID_CZS) inside the owid_alt windows declared in data/history/actors.yaml; empire-wide actors (data/history/actors.yaml `derived_series`) are the population-weighted mean of their constituent successor-state series, log-linearly interpolated between Maddison benchmark years; a gap inside an actor's own observed Maddison range is filled by log-linear interpolation (never extrapolated, never across a gap > 40y) and flagged in gdp_pc_interp; past the actor's own last Maddison year gdp_pc is chained on the World Bank PPP series' year-on-year growth rate (no level join, so no jump at the seam), and where Maddison has no row at all it is that series level-matched to Maddison (geometric-mean ratio on the actor's last 10 overlap years, else the pooled ratio exp(-0.195) over 1589 actor-years). Every filled year is flagged in gdp_pc_wb
sources.population: OWID population (HYDE/Gapminder/UN); empire-wide actors are the share-weighted sum of their constituent successor-state series; successor-borders series dropped before `successor_borders_until` (data/history/actors.yaml); build guard |log(population/tpop)| <= 0.3 on every live actor-year, exemptions declared in data/history/population_guard.yaml
sources.regime: V-Dem Regimes of the World via OWID (0 closed aut, 1 electoral aut, 2 electoral dem, 3 liberal dem); 43 interior single-year holes carried from the year before (era-modern-2000-2025/data-5), flagged in regime_imputed
sources.regime_imputed: derived: 1 where the V-Dem RoW category was missing for a single year inside the actor's own observed run and was carried from the previous year. Imputation, not an observation
sources.energy_twh: OWID energy by source (Energy Institute + Smil)
sources.oil_prod: OWID fossil production (Energy Institute, Etemad & Luciani)
sources.coal_prod: OWID fossil production (Energy Institute, Etemad & Luciani)
sources.coup_attempt: REIGN 2021.8 (1950–2021), Powell–Thyne coups; extended past REIGN's 2021 end by 12 hand-coded attempts through 2025 (data/history/events.yaml, era-modern-2000-2025/data-3)
sources.leader_irregular_entry: REIGN 2021.8, derived: the sitting leader's entry is irregular iff exp(irregular) ≤ tenure_months at the first month of the spell (the raw `irregular` column is log months since the last irregular change, not a flag)
sources.irregular_recency_months: REIGN 2021.8 `irregular`, exponentiated: months since the state's last irregular leader change (display only)
sources.coup_success: REIGN 2021.8 (1950–2021), Powell–Thyne coups; extended past REIGN's 2021 end by 12 hand-coded attempts through 2025 (data/history/events.yaml, era-modern-2000-2025/data-3)
sources.defence_pacts: count of DISTINCT defence-pact partners per actor-year. CoW Formal Alliances 3.03 dyadic sstype 1 (1816-2000), ATOP 5.1 atop_defense (2001-2018, scripts/fetch-atop.mjs), the 2018 edge set carried forward past it, and dated `kind: pact` rows in data/history/events.yaml for the accessions after 2018. Values from 2019 are the 2018 edge set carried forward plus the dated accessions, not a measurement of those years. NOTE the level halved on 2026-09-07 (era-1991-2026-r2/data-7): both CoW 3.03 and ATOP ship DIRECTED dyad-years, so the previous construction counted every partner twice and the column was 2x the partner count its own label claimed. It feeds no template
sources.pact_rus: a defence pact with USA / USSR-Russia in the dated alliance graph: CoW Formal Alliances 3.03 dyadic sstype 1 (1816-2000), ATOP 5.1 atop_defense (2001-2018, scripts/fetch-atop.mjs), the 2018 edge set carried forward past it, and dated `kind: pact` rows in data/history/events.yaml for the accessions after 2018
sources.pact_usa: a defence pact with USA / USSR-Russia in the dated alliance graph: CoW Formal Alliances 3.03 dyadic sstype 1 (1816-2000), ATOP 5.1 atop_defense (2001-2018, scripts/fetch-atop.mjs), the 2018 edge set carried forward past it, and dated `kind: pact` rows in data/history/events.yaml for the accessions after 2018
sources.mid_war: CoW MID 3.02 participant-level (1816–2001) spliced with GML MID 2.2.1 directed dyad-years (2002–2010, scripts/fetch-mid.mjs); hostility level ≥ 4 (mid_force) / ≥ 5 (mid_war). 2011–2026 has no MID source and is null, not 0
sources.mid_force: CoW MID 3.02 participant-level (1816–2001) spliced with GML MID 2.2.1 directed dyad-years (2002–2010, scripts/fetch-mid.mjs); hostility level ≥ 4 (mid_force) / ≥ 5 (mid_war). 2011–2026 has no MID source and is null, not 0
sources.at_war: union of two sources: data/history/events.yaml, a HAND LIST of interstate wars with per-participant entry/exit dates where declared (complete only where the refine loop has been), and UCDP/PRIO ACD 25.1 type-2 (interstate) conflict-years 1946-2024 for every actor-year the hand list does not name (era-1991-2026-r2/data-2). Outside 1946-2024 the hand list is the only source and absence is still not evidence of peace; ingesting CoW Inter-State War v4.0 participant-level dates the way NMC 7.0 was ingested is what would close the pre-1946 half (docs/escalations.md); in an occupied year at_war keeps the 1 the war list gives it and is null otherwise (an occupied year is not a peaceful one)
sources.at_war_ucdp: derived: 1 where the at_war year came from UCDP/PRIO type-2 rather than the hand war list, 0 where the hand list carries it (or where neither does), null outside UCDP 1946-2024
sources.info_access: derived: max(internet users/100, mobile subs/100, fixed lines/40); 0.02 before 1960
sources.occupied: data/history/events.yaml kind: occupation — 1 for the fully occupied years (ceil(start)..floor(end)) of every dated occupation span; the invasion year keeps its war
sources.gdp_pc_interp: share of the derived gdp_pc weight that came from a log-linear interpolation between Maddison benchmark years (1 = no annual observation behind the value); derived: 1 where gdp_pc was log-linearly interpolated between the actor's own observed Maddison years (no annual observation behind the value, and its gdp_growth is a smooth fill)

sources.gdp_pc_wb: derived: 1 where gdp_pc was spliced from the World Bank PPP series (data/variables.yaml gdp_pc_ppp) because Maddison has no row for that actor-year
sources.cinc_spliced: 0 where cinc is CoW NMC's own measurement, 1 where it is the modern composite spliced onto it (scripts/lib/capability.mjs); composite vs CINC 1990-2022 r=0.964 (n=6182), log r=0.981. The extension is used for RANKS and RATIOS, so the acceptance test is not the pooled level correlation alone (era-1991-2026-r2/statistics-7): worst-year Spearman 0.975 (2000), and the largest displacement of a CINC top-20 actor in the composite's own ranking is 43 places (PRK, 2022) — the composite drops CINC's military-personnel indicator and stands GDP at PPP in for iron and steel, which moves conscript-heavy poor states down and small rich states up
sources.cinc_carried: derived: years since the actor's cinc was last measured. 0 for a CoW NMC value and for a composite-extended one; > 0 where the actor is live past 2022 but the composite cannot reach it (fewer than the required components in the World Bank / OWID series, which are not published for sanctioned or unrecognised states) or its splice factor is too far from 1 to be a level correction, so its last CINC-scale value is carried instead of the actor vanishing from the column (era-1991-2026-r2/data-3, statistics-7). Actors whose factor was refused: AND, ATG, BHS, CRI, DMA, ERI, GRD, IRL, ISL, KIR, KNA, LCA, MDV, MHL, MLT, NRU, PAN, PLW, PRK, SLB, SMR, SSD, SYC, TON, TUV, VCT, VUT, WSM
sources.industry_share: derived (operator/capability-waves): the actor's share of world industrial output among live actors. Stage 1 is CoW NMC iron and steel where observed, else NMC primary energy, else OWID/EI electricity generation, each rescaled onto the steel scale by that year's median ratio over the actors reporting both, and normalised to a world share. Stage 2 redistributes the World Bank manufacturing-value-added block's OWN stage-1 aggregate among the actors that series covers (1960-2024), so partial coverage cannot inflate a covered actor. A live actor-year with none of the four carries its last computed share and records the age in industry_share_carried
sources.industry_share_carried: derived: years since industry_share was last computed from a source. > 0 means the share is carried — the World Bank publishes US manufacturing value added only through 2021 and CoW NMC ends in 2022, so the largest economies are carried in 2023-2025 (the package names UNIDO or BEA as the fix)
sources.wave_share: derived (operator/capability-waves): the wave-weighted capability share — sum over the waves alive in the year of weight(t) x attained x industry_share^mass, plus 0.25 x industry_share for the capability no coded wave carries, normalised over live actors (src/engine/waves.js). Attainment here is the observed sovereign_by dates in data/waves.yaml; forward in the engine it is the fitted wave_attain hazard
sources.wave_attained: derived: the displacement-weighted fraction of the waves alive in the year that the actor is sovereign in, before any mass discount (src/engine/waves.js waveWeight)
sources.aid_recipient: derived from World Bank WDI DT.ODA.ODAT.GN.ZS: 1 where the actor appears in the ODA/GNI recipient series in any year, 0 where it never does (a donor or graduated high-income state), null before the series starts
sources.pol_mass: projection-weighted capability share: geometric mean of the CINC share and the military-expenditure share over live actors (weight 0.5); milex from CoW NMC 7.0 to 2022, World Bank MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS x NY.GDP.MKTP.CD after (src/engine/polarity.js)
sources.pol_share: pol_mass smoothed with an EWMA, lambda=0.75 (src/engine/polarity.js) — the state polarity is classified from
sources.hegemon_share: derived: poles are the actors above the first gap of 2x in the ranked pol_share; 1 pole = unipolar, 2 = bipolar, else multipolar (src/engine/polarity.js). Longest derived eras: bipolar 1950-1994, unipolar 1995-2014
sources.is_hegemon: derived: poles are the actors above the first gap of 2x in the ranked pol_share; 1 pole = unipolar, 2 = bipolar, else multipolar (src/engine/polarity.js). Longest derived eras: bipolar 1950-1994, unipolar 1995-2014
sources.n_poles: derived: poles are the actors above the first gap of 2x in the ranked pol_share; 1 pole = unipolar, 2 = bipolar, else multipolar (src/engine/polarity.js). Longest derived eras: bipolar 1950-1994, unipolar 1995-2014
sources.multipolar: derived: poles are the actors above the first gap of 2x in the ranked pol_share; 1 pole = unipolar, 2 = bipolar, else multipolar (src/engine/polarity.js). Longest derived eras: bipolar 1950-1994, unipolar 1995-2014
sources.unipolar: derived: poles are the actors above the first gap of 2x in the ranked pol_share; 1 pole = unipolar, 2 = bipolar, else multipolar (src/engine/polarity.js). Longest derived eras: bipolar 1950-1994, unipolar 1995-2014
sources.bipolar: derived: poles are the actors above the first gap of 2x in the ranked pol_share; 1 pole = unipolar, 2 = bipolar, else multipolar (src/engine/polarity.js). Longest derived eras: bipolar 1950-1994, unipolar 1995-2014
sources.cold_war: derived: the world is bipolar (replaces the typed year <= 1991; cold_war_dates keeps it for one run)
sources.promotion_era: derived: unipolar and the hegemon's own regime >= 2 (replaces the typed 1992-2016)
sources.anticoup_norm: derived: at least 0.5 of live states score regime >= 2 (replaces the typed year >= 2000; anticoup_norm_dates keeps it for one run)
sources.dem_share: share of live actors WITH A REGIME SCORE scoring >= 2 (V-Dem RoW). The denominator is the observed set, not the live set — era-1991-2026-r2/data-4 and statistics-5: 22 live states (the Caribbean and Pacific parliamentary democracies and the four European microstates) have no V-Dem row in any year, so at 2024 the share is 85/173 = 0.491 over observed actors against 195 live, and the anticoup_norm flag that reads it switches off on the boundary of V-Dem's country list rather than on a fall in the democratic share. panel.meta.polarity carries dem_share_n (the denominator) and dem_share_live beside it every year so the coverage is visible; filling the 22 from a sourced series that has them is docs/escalations.md era-1991-2026-r2/data-4
sources.capability_carried: panel.meta.polarity only: years since the capability distribution the polarity classification was computed from was last measured (0 = measured in that year)
sources.hegemon_regime: derived: the regime score of the top actor by pol_share (replaces the typed largest-power-by-date rule; hegemon_regime_dates keeps it for one run)
sources.great_game: derived: superpower client x bipolar world (bipolar is now derived; great_game_dates keeps the typed-era version for one run)
sources.aid_conditionality: derived: ODA/GNI capped at 30% in tens during the derived promotion era, a structural zero outside it. Inside the era a missing ODA/GNI row is a structural zero too — the World Bank series covers recipients only, so its silence about a donor or a graduated state is "receives no measurable aid" and not a missing observation (era-1991-2026-r2/statistics-4, data-6). The aid_recipient column keeps "never in the series" separable from "in it in some years"

Operation Weserubung 9 Apr 1940: Denmark occupied, the Belts and the Sound pass under German control and the Baltic exits are mined — the Baltic is a closed German sea for five years (occupation record: DNK 1940.27-1945.35)
Italian entry 10 Jun 1940: the Massawa squadron makes the Red Sea a war zone, closed to US shipping by the combat-zone proclamation, and Middle East supply reroutes round the Cape
Italian entry 10 Jun 1940 closes the Mediterranean approach; Allied through-traffic reroutes via the Cape
Italian entry 10 Jun 1940: Allied through-traffic reroutes via the Cape
armistice 22 Jun 1940; Paris liberated 25 Aug 1944; the Fourth Republic constitution 27 Oct 1946 seats its first legislature in Jan 1947 (imposed_until)

the French armistice 22 Jun 1940 puts the southern shore in German hands; the Channel is closed to British through-convoys after convoy CW9 (Aug 1940) and is fought over by artillery and E-boats for four years
the French armistice 22 Jun 1940 puts the T-branch to Tripoli inside Vichy Syria and it stops pumping; only the Haifa line runs

incorporation as Soviet republics 3-6 Aug 1940; the three actors leave system membership until 1991
German 'training troops' into Romania 12 Oct 1940 to garrison the oilfields; the Danube becomes the Reich's main crude import

transfer of sovereignty 27 Dec 1949: both shores are Indonesian. The record carried NLD forward to 2026 — 31 years of a colonial power holding a strait it had left (era-1945-1991-r2/corridors-3)
the transfer of sovereignty of 27 Dec 1949 explicitly leaves New Guinea out and defers it one year; the deferral holds for thirteen
